admission.justification: dashboard/src/cockpit/Cockpit.tsx keeps the role pane mounted, PaseoChatFrame.tsx retains the iframe and gates IN_REACH on confirmed shown or explicit urlOnly, and paseoFrameControl.ts steers ready-channel changes without destructive cold-load reloads, preventing view switches, slow initial loads, and stripped query parameters from discarding or stranding the native chat.

applicability: Normal dashboard view switches, result reads, ready-channel execution changes, and unavailable-control wait/recovery handling on the embedded chat frame.
conditions: The pane remains under the existing hidden persistent ViewLayer.
The frame descriptor and frame generation remain unchanged across ready switches, responsive late answers, post-onLoad readiness timeouts, and the 45 s cold-load cap.
When control is unavailable without an explicit plug-in report lacking open-agent, landed === agentId without confirmed shown stays under a waiting notice with Retry rather than IN_REACH.
exclusions: Explicit Retry while control is unavailable, host return, unanswered ping after an open-request deadline, subsequent unavailable selection after load timeout, and explicit absence of open-agent capability may create a new frame generation.
The dashboard removed sidebar and launcher button are not chat navigation; the host list and ready frame channel are.
DOM retention promises no stronger draft/scroll preservation than native application behavior and no guarantee for unrelated session/PTY paths.

origin.handoffEntry: PNT-R15@v1 / PNT-R16@v1 persistent Chats and inline navigation

statement: Chats keeps one persistent native frame across dashboard view/result changes and supported ready-channel execution steering. It adds no stronger draft/scroll guarantee than native application behavior. Explicit Retry while unavailable (ready Retry resends ar.open without reload), host return, silence after an open-request deadline plus unanswered ping, subsequent unavailable selection after load timeout, and explicit lack of open-agent capability are the qualified new-generation paths; a responsive late answer, a post-onLoad readiness timeout, and the 45 s outer cold-load cap settle without reloading while accepting late ready or pong. When control is unavailable without an explicit plug-in report lacking open-agent, an unconfirmed URL-landed agent is not in reach and keeps the waiting notice with Retry.
title: Persistent native chat frame and qualified reload and in-reach bounds
